senses.gloss:
मोद मोद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. मुद्), pleasure,
delight, gladness, joyousness, joyfulness; fragrance,
perfume [cf. आ-मोद]; N. of a Muni; (आ), f. =
अज-मोदा, q. v.
—मोद-कर, अस्, m., N. of a
Muni.
—मोद-मोदिनी, f. ‘delighting by fragrance,’
Eugenia Jambolana (= जम्बु).
—मोदाख्य (˚द-
आख्˚), अस्, m. the mango tree.
—मोदा-गिरि, इस्,
m., N. of a country.
—मोदाढ्या (˚द-आढ्˚), f.
= अज-मोदा, q. v.
—मोदा-पुर, अम्, n., N. of
a city.

मोदक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, delighting, rejoicing,
pleasing, gladdening, exhilarating, causing happiness
or delight; glad, cheerful; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a small
round sweetmeat or a sweetmeat in general; (in
medicine) a sort of pill; (अस्), m. a particular mixed
caste (the son of a Kṣatriya by a Śūdra mother);
(अम्), n. a kind of metre, four times ¯˘˘¯˘˘¯
˘˘¯˘˘¯; (ई), f., N. of a particular mythical club
or weapon.
—मोदक-कार, अस्, m. a sweetmeat-
maker, confectioner.
—मोदक-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
composed of sweetmeats.
—मोदक-शराव, अस्,
अम्, m. n. a dish of sweetmeats.

मोदकिका, f. (at the end of a comp. after nu-
merals), a sweetmeat.

मोदन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus.), giving joy,
gratifying, gladdening, delighting, (generally at the
end of a comp., e. g. क्रव्याद-गण-मोदन,
giving joy to numbers of beasts of prey, Mahā-bh.
Droṇa-p. 1576); (अम्), n. the act of pleasing or
affording pleasure; joy, pleasure; = उच्छिष्ट-मो-
दन, wax.

मोदनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rejoiced at, to be
delighted in, delightful.
मोदमान, अस्, आ, अम्, rejoicing, being glad.

मोदाकिन्, ई, m. (probably) N. of a hill (Mahā-bh.
Bhīṣma-p. 427).
मोदायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Moda.

मोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, gratified, delighted;
(अम्), n. pleasure, delight.

मोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, rejoicing, glad, pleased, cheerful,
merry, happy; making glad, gladdening, gratifying,
delighting, (often at the end of comps., cf. गीत-म्˚);
(इनी), f., N. of various plants (= अज-मोदा, मल्-
लिका, यूथिका, वृत्त-मल्लिका); musk; an intoxi-
cating beverage.
मोदोष, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
